book.name: 1 Abhatesaronike
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhatesaronike

content: Mubhuteero tukatamwa okukongʼera, kwo okubha tutaamenyiri gano gakukorwa eyo. Niho tukarora kubha, etwe tusaage abheene mumugye gwa Atene,
tukamutuma Timoteo omuhiiri weetu, okubha yiize abhagumirye no okubhagosorerya mubhwiikirirya bhweenyu. Ewe ni mubhagati omurikyeetu wa Taatabhugya, wo okurwaaza Amangʼana Amazomu iguru wa Krisito.
Tukakora ego, okubha omuutu wowoosi gati weenyu atakwa ekoro kwe ekigirirye kye enyaako yino mukabhona. Emwe mumenyiri kubha, tureenderwa okuhitira enyaako.
Mumenyiri gayo, kwo okubha hano twaari neemwe, tukabhabhuurira kubha turanyaakibhwa. Bhoono niigo gaatuukiri.

Kino nikyo kyagirirye nikatamwa okwiikongʼeererya, nikamutuma Timoteo kweemwe, okubha nimenye amangʼana iguru yo obhwiikirirya bhweenyu. Nikakora ego, kwo okubha ataaza omuzoogenia wurya Seetaani abhe amariri okubhasakya no okubhabhurya. Niho emirimo gyoosi gino tukoriri kweemwe, gibhe gya bhusa.
Timoteo areetiri Amangʼana Amazomu okurwa ku Bhatesaronike

Nawe bhoono, Timoteo yiiziri okurwa kweemwe, atubhuuriiri amangʼana amazomu iguru yo obhwiikirirya no obhuseegi bhweenyu. Atubhuuriiri kubha muratuhiita bhuzomu eriibhaga ryoosi, na muratwiigoomba okurorena neetwe, kyeego neetwe twaari tureenda okurorena neemwe.
Abhahiiri bheetu, amangʼana iguru yo obhwiikirirya bhweenyu gatugumiriirye eziikoro, mutaabhu ne enyaako yeetu yoosi.
Bhoono turaheezera, kwo okubha twiigwiiri mwiimeereeri obhugumiru ku Mukuru Yeesu.

Bhoono turanagya kumuriha Taatabhugya kigiroki, okubha azomirye kwe ekigirirye kyo obhwiikirirya bhweenyu? Naabhe kwe ekigirirye kyo obhuzomererwa bhukuru bhuno tunabhwe embere wa Taatabhugya kwiiguru weenyu?
Turamusabha Taatabhugya kwo omukya obhutiku no omwiisi, atusakirye tuuze kweeki kweemwe, okubha tubhasakirye kino musuhiirwe iguru yo obhwiikirirya bhweenyu.
Turamusabha Taatabhugya omweene, Taata weetu, no Omukuru weetu Yeesu, atubhanurire enzira yo okuuza kweemwe.
Omukuru Yeesu abhoongerye no okukiraho obhuseegi bhwo okuseegana emwe kwa neemwe no okubhaseega abhaandi bhoosi, kyeego etwe tubhaseegiri emwe.
Kweeki abhagumirye eziikoro zyeenyu, okubha mubhe abhaatu abhahoreeru mutana amasoro embere wa Taata weetu Taatabhugya, eriibhaga rino Omukuru weetu Yeesu araaze hamwe na abhahoreeru bhaaye bhoosi.

footnotes.text: Abhahoreeru bhaaye bhoosi, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, bhamaraika, kasi Abhakrisito bhano bhakuuri. Rora abhahoreeru mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
